payload.core_mechanism_summary: Maintains prefix hashes via random multipliers to detect subarrays with all counts ≡ 0 mod 3, while sliding a left pointer to enforce ≤3 occurrences per element.
payload.rationale: The solution critically depends on a hash map (Counter) to count prefix hash frequencies and efficiently find matching subarrays; the sliding window is auxiliary to restrict counts, making hashing the core mechanism.
